en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a relatively wide, tree‑lined street bordered by multi‑story masonry buildings with shop windows on the right and a fenced area with bare trees on the left. A few pedestrians and a dog walk along the sidewalk. At the top the printed caption reads "Hamar. Strandgaden." and there is handwritten cursive text over the lower left and center of the image.
